findings.title: Adaptive-practice screenshot alt text names the wrong category
findings.problem: The changed adaptive-practice image visibly shows a PSYCHOSOCIAL INTEGRITY question, but its alt text still describes a pharmacology question.
findings.failure_scenario: A screen-reader user is told the screenshot depicts pharmacology when it depicts therapeutic communication, so the accessible description misrepresents the study content.
findings.fix: Change the alt text to describe the visible psychosocial-integrity question, then regenerate or verify the product-image evidence.

findings.title: Comparison pages retain stale last-verified dates after edits
findings.problem: The UWorld and Archer comparison entries retain `updated: "2026-10-10"` even though this change edits their copy and refreshes their source access dates to 2026-10-28. The rendered page uses the `updated` value as its visible last-verified date and Article `dateModified`.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader sees a page marked last verified October 10 even though its copy and cited-source checks were updated October 28.
findings.fix: Update the `updated` dates for the edited entries to 2026-10-28 and regenerate the rendered pages and comparison evidence.

assessment: The diagram-pairing change separates branch-supplied diagrams from bank questions as intended. I found two user-facing accuracy issues in the changed public materials.
